result.summary: Refactors transaction input and output initialization in `txpackage_tests`, `bench/duplicate_inputs`, and `script_p2sh_tests`. Replaces field-by-field struct assignments with declarative constructor calls for `COutPoint`, `CTxIn`, and `CTxOut`. Transaction construction behavior and test inputs remain identical.
result.problem: Test transaction inputs and outputs are constructed through procedural field-by-field mutations across several unit tests and benchmarks, making test setup code verbose and inconsistent with newer declarative test patterns.
evidence: Author states it is part of tracking issue #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data') and follows merged PR #36750 (PR description)
Commit messages confirm constructed transactions remain functionally unchanged (commits 5336eaa, 7fc7d26, a4a2647)
result.scope_notes: Diff touches only unit test and benchmark files without altering test coverage or production code.
result.card: This PR refactors transaction input and output construction in txpackage unit tests, script_p2sh unit tests, and duplicate_inputs benchmarks to use declarative constructor calls instead of procedural field assignments. It addresses verbose and inconsistent test transaction setup across test suites as part of tracking issue #36692. No transaction generation semantics or test logic are changed.

risk.why: Only test harnesses and benchmarks are modified; an error would at most cause unit tests or benchmarks to fail without impacting production node operation.
